technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot 3.x with Java 17+ as the base framework for all new modules and deployers.
Implement SPI deployers as separate Maven modules to allow independent builds and releases.
Replace XD-specific exceptions with Spring Cloud Stream standard exceptions.
Use Spring Cloud Stream functional programming model for new modules.
Integrate YARN deployment using Spring Cloud Hadoop for compatibility with existing Hadoop clusters.
Package SFTP source module as a Spring Cloud Stream app starter following the latest conventions.
Use GitHub Actions for CI pipeline implementation across all repositories.
Leverage Spring Cloud Data Flow's existing module registry for OOTB module availability.
assumptions: Developers have prior experience with Spring Cloud ecosystem and Java 17.
Existing CI infrastructure and test environments are available for use.
Maven-based build system is used across all modules and deployers.
Documentation updates are included as part of each development task.
Unit and integration tests are written alongside implementation code.
The team size is 3 developers working in parallel on different components.
No major architectural redesign is needed beyond what is specified in the user stories.
Dependencies on external systems like Hadoop and GemFire are available for testing.
